lead.title: llama.cpp ships builds b12820–b12823 with CUDA and ggml-zdnn fixes
lead.summary: Four builds landed on November 28, headlined by a fix for CUDA ADD_ID launches beyond 65535 tokens on NVIDIA and HIP, plus better zTensor memory visibility in the ggml-zdnn backend. The same build line is what Ollama v0.40.19 bundles via its llama-server bump, so the fixes propagate to the most common local stacks immediately.

top_stories.title: Beijing's AI ambitions under threat as models may fall behind by up to nine months
top_stories.summary: Tom's Hardware reports that tightened US export-control rules on renting overseas GPU compute are slowing Chinese AI labs, with Zhipu AI's GLM-5.5 release slipping and model gaps possibly widening from 3-6 to nine months. Access to Nvidia accelerators remains the binding constraint for local and lab-scale model development.

top_stories.title: n8n 3.0 pre-release: self-hosters should prep via Migration Report before the stable jump
top_stories.summary: n8n 3.x builds (3.0.0–3.2.0) remain pre-releases with 2.49.x the current stable; npm installs stop working at 3.0. Breaking changes include mandatory Slack signing secrets, default encryption-key rotation and an expanded SSRF block list (adds 100.64.0.0/10), so backing up and clearing the Settings > Migration Report is the recommended path.

top_stories.title: Community benchmark: MTPLX beats mlx-serve and oMLX for Mac local inference, at a TTFT cost
top_stories.summary: A controlled r/LocalLLaMA comparison on an M5 Max (Inkling 2 Mini, same seeds/prompts) measured average decode of 85.0 / 73.8 / 57.6 tok/s for MTPLX / mlx-serve / oMLX, with vendor quant packs faster again. mlx-serve wins cold time-to-first-token (~1.5 s vs ~1.8 s), a practical tuning note for Mac homelab stacks.

top_stories.title: Hugging Face launches AI Model Market Daily, a stock-board view of the model market
top_stories.summary: A new daily board ranks AI models on token sales, intelligence and security by combining official Hugging Face benchmark boards, SuperCLUE, LMArena, OpenRouter token sales and supply-chain scans. The November 27 snapshot tracked 885 models and ranked 211 open-weight models.

items.title: KVAE-3.0 tokenizer family released for audio, image and video
items.summary: Kandinsky Lab's new latent-alignment tokenizers for diffusion pipelines: KVAE-2D-3.0 halves parameters at matched reconstruction quality, KVAE-3D-3.0 doubles video compression to 4x32x32 with 128 channels, and a 48 kHz stereo audio VAE beats Stable Audio 3 and LTX-2.5 in human-preference win rates. Code and weights are public.

items.title: hs-decide-1-flash: 0.8B decision model with image input and 131K context
items.summary: A Qwen3.5-based decision model that returns probabilities for typed choice/score/yes-no questions in a single forward pass — no generated text. Adds image input and grows trained request length to 131,072 tokens; serves via vLLM, MLX or Transformers.

items.title: OpenThai 2.2 OCR: 0.6B Thai/English document-to-Markdown model, 3x faster
items.summary: A 0.6B fine-tune of NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Parse for Thai + English pages to Markdown with HTML tables. Beats Typhoon OCR V2 0.8B on Thai tables (+6.0) and printed text (+5.5), runs ~3x faster with the DFlash2 drafter (~8 GB VRAM); a 2M-param CPU-only text OCR ships alongside.

items.title: Inkling-2-Mini-Unbound v3: uncensored reasoning model trims over-thinking
items.summary: v3 of the drop-in uncensored variant of Thinking Machines' 26B Inkling 2 Mini. A Prime LoRA add-on trained only on harmless tasks cuts median thinking tokens from 344 to 184 and lifts hard debugging solves from 73.3% to 100%; same architecture, files and chat template, plus GGUF packs for llama.cpp.

items.title: Qwen3.8-27B GGUF ecosystem expands: GSQ re-optimized Q2_K and NariQ ternary quants
items.summary: Multiple local-inference quant packs for Qwen3.8-27B updated on November 27: Xylolabs re-optimized its Q2_K with GSQ (lower KL at the same size), joining nari-labs' NariQ 3.0/2.5/2.0 bpw builds (~10 GB at 3 bpw) and prism-ml's 1.76-bpw ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B (5.93 GB, 262K context) for llama.cpp and MLX.

items.title: Show HN: A 52 KB WebAssembly engine that runs Qwen3.5-2B in a browser tab
items.summary: Tesseracted presents a 52 KB WebAssembly inference engine that runs Qwen3.5-2B entirely inside a browser tab, keeping local inference dependency-free and offline-capable, demonstrated with an in-browser experiments page.

items.title: Show HN: Sentinel, a live monitoring tool for coding agent sabotage
items.summary: Sentinel (run-llama/sentinel) checks whether coding agents were sabotaged via poisoned context or injected instructions, targeting local agent setups that need quick, on-machine validation of agent behavior.

items.title: Show HN: WikiVectors makes any LLM smarter
items.summary: A compact structured-knowledge layer that plugs into local LLMs to improve answer grounding without a heavyweight cloud retrieval stack — useful for offline RAG-style setups on constrained hardware.

items.title: n8n still ships Node 26.13.0 in Docker images after November Node.js security release
items.summary: Stable 2.49.6 and next 2.50.1 images still bundle Node 26.13.0, missing the November Node.js HTTP/2/HTTPS security fixes. A community moderator confirms the bump to Node 26.13.1 is tracked in open PR #45157 with no announced date for a stable image.
